extensions.title: Extension overview
extensions.intro: Review installed plugins and themes, and upload ZIP extension packages with an SForum manifest.
extensions.rolledBack: Extension rolled back to the selected historical version.
extensions.upgradeStagedHint: The candidate was saved. The current version continues running and activation requires trusted upgrade confirmation.
extensions.upgradedReEnableHint: Status was reset to installed. Re-enable the plugin to start it again.
extensions.upgradedTrustRevokedHint: Package digest changed, so frontend trust was revoked. Re-enable and re-grant trusted admin components.
extensions.confirmUninstallBody: This removes “{name}” and its settings by default. Disable it first; built-in/system extensions cannot be uninstalled.
extensions.confirmUninstallV2Body: This runs the recoverable trusted uninstall flow for “{name}”. Its package, runtime recovery material, and last successful authority remain available until terminal success.

preserve.label: Preserve data (recommended)
preserve.description: Uninstall code and Host registrations while retaining plugin data for a later reinstall.
preserve.warning: Plugin data remains. Credentials, tokens, and Host-managed registrations are still revoked by the uninstall flow.

export.label: Export, then remove
export.description: Require the plugin to create a verifiable export artifact before removing its data.
export.warning: The Host continues only after the uninstall hook returns a durable export ID and digest; missing evidence fails closed.

complete.label: Complete removal
complete.description: Remove plugin data, package, and Host-managed resources.
complete.warning: This is irreversible. External resources remain owned by plugin hooks; a hook failure retains the package and recovery material.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle history
lifecycle.emptyDescription: This plugin has not run through the V2 lifecycle coordinator yet.
lifecycle.loadFailed: Lifecycle history could not be loaded.
lifecycle.retrySuccess: The failed lifecycle step was recovered and retried.
lifecycle.skipSuccess: The skippable step was skipped with an audited decision.

recovery.title: Recover failed operation
recovery.retryDescription: Resume with the original exact artifact, frozen authority, idempotency key, and checkpoint, while recording a new audit event.
recovery.skipDescription: Available only for plugin steps explicitly marked skippable by the lifecycle contract.
recovery.skipRisk: Host safety gates can never be skipped. Skipping plugin cleanup may leave external resources, and uninstall also requires explicit forced escalation.
recovery.forceSuperAdmin: Only an active super administrator can accept residual-resource risk.
recovery.forceRiskDescription: Forced uninstall continues revoking Host registrations, tokens, and managed namespaces, but cannot prove that webhooks, SaaS subscriptions, cloud resources, or external data were removed.
recovery.forceAcknowledge: I understand external resources may remain and accept responsibility for manual follow-up cleanup.
recovery.reasonDescription: Required for skip or forced uninstall and stored verbatim with the durable audit decision.

extensions.themeActivated: Theme activated. The public Page Registry and static assets have switched.

frontend.title: Trusted admin components
frontend.prebuiltDescription: The component comes from the installed extension package and loads through an immutable digest URL. It is fully trusted code, not a sandbox; declining trust keeps the declarative settings available.
frontend.fullTrustTitle: This code has administrator browser authority
frontend.fullTrustDescription: The {name} v{version} component can call its namespaced API, change settings, and navigate the admin on your behalf. The host does not pass Cookie or Authorization values to it, but the code must still be treated as fully trusted.
frontend.confirmCode: Re-enter the one-time confirmation code below (valid for 5 minutes)
frontend.confirmAcknowledge: I understand this is not a sandbox and trust this exact version, API, component ID, and digest.
frontend.exactTrustDescription: This admin component is part of the extension's exact-artifact impact document. Complete super-admin confirmation from the plugin enable action; declarative Schema settings remain available until then.

trust.title: Review exact artifact and enable
trust.body: Review the complete server-generated impact document before enabling “{name}”.
trust.fullTrustTitle: This action will run fully trusted code
trust.fullTrustDescription: Confirmation binds the current version, package and executable digests, routes, migrations, admin components, authority, dependencies, and API contracts. Capability declarations are disclosure, not a security sandbox.
trust.blockingError: This artifact cannot be enabled safely
trust.previewFailed: The exact-artifact impact preview could not be loaded.
trust.challengeFailed: A one-use trust challenge could not be issued.
trust.delegatedPreviewOnly: You can review the complete impact, but only an active super administrator can authorize and first run this artifact.
trust.challengeReadyDescription: The token stays only in this page and is consumed once when you confirm enable. Any artifact change requires a new challenge.

databaseRisk.missingRequiredBackupWarning: The migration plan does not require a backup. Create a restorable backup or export before enabling.
databaseRisk.backupGuidanceDescription: Before authorizing this exact artifact, verify that the latest database backup can be restored and retain an export of plugin data.

basic.loginMaxFailuresHint: Lock the account after this many consecutive wrong passwords. 0 disables lockout. Recommended: 10.
basic.loginLockoutMinutesHint: How long login stays blocked after the threshold is hit. 0 means unlock immediately. Recommended: 15.
